method.http: Same-origin ResourceTiming startTime to responseEnd is local proxy HTTP round-trip plus body completion, not server CPU time. Request/header fields reported as null when unavailable (zero); header and body summaries omit unavailable entries.
method.timing: Browser PerformanceResourceTiming.responseEnd to semantic DOM observer readiness, then two requestAnimationFrame callbacks. Includes browser scheduling/style/layout; not isolated React CPU time or physical paint confirmation.
method.chromiumMetrics: CDP Performance.getMetrics cumulative deltas from before run click to observed settled readiness (and separately per event click). Includes run-loading UI, fetch/JSON handling and test-driver scheduling; duration values are seconds, counts are counts. No CPU throttling.
method.limits: Response bytes are the decoded UTF-8 JSON body, not compressed wire bytes. Local Chromium, one worker and warmed Java/browser asset caches. Raw warmups retained but excluded from summaries; no percentile or threshold claim. Controls/route loading excluded from response-to-ready interval. No production capacity, p95, screen-reader, zoom or learning-effectiveness claim.

archive.inputEncoding: Full generated inputs remain in CI artifacts and fixture factories. This archive replaces each input with SHA-256 of canonical JSON (UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False), preserving every timing sample and summary.
